question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendments introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**101st Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **101st Constitutional Amendment Act** introduced the **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** in India.
 
• The Amendment was passed by the **Parliament of India** in **2016** and came into effect on **1st July 2017**.
